title: 初一完整十五题：读者日、学校图景与三首诗
instruction: 阅读A、B、C、D四组全部材料，回答第1至第15题；每题从A、B、C、D四个候选中选出最合适的一项。第6题的候选是四幅图。每题2分，共30分。活动、人物、学校学习故事及诗歌均为虚构；A组日期依据所给月份日历。
source_notice: 参照常熟2018—2019学年上学期初一官方教育教研门户发布的完整阅读节：A月历与家庭节日信息3题，B学校教师说明及四幅人物候选图3题，C记忆/语言学习说明4题，D三首编号诗与四词注5题，共15四选、每题2分30分。原发布文字/必要图和键图已归档，原校施测及低清图精细信息未独立认证，原键非gold；源日历星期头低清未猜字，B缺动词、D错拼及记忆/家庭概括保留不修成gold。新A三套虚构地方活动配真实可核日历，B为自绘四人示意非原照片重建，不作视觉或认知难度等值；第6题四图按2×2显示，以同一组年龄/发型/墨镜和树枝位置辨人，无人物姓名图标签。C为虚构学校学习routine，不冒普遍儿童记忆实验或双语发展证据。D三首完整新诗保分行分节及feed/fur/sweep/count四词注，正文/题干/文字候选/日历标签数字/图像与输出分计；作者诗行长度不同于源，不称词数或难度等值。三稿同源结构/主题家族，逐题依据与排除理由是作者自审，不作独立教研、学生、商用或生产验证。

sections.label: A
units:
Brook Club celebrates its Readers’ Day on the second Sunday in September 2028. The club at Pine Hill chooses September 20. These local events belong to our story, and neither club must follow the other’s calendar. At Brook, families bring a favourite page to read aloud together.

The helpers prepare seats and place books where young readers can reach them. They arrive before the families and stay to put everything away. Some visitors know the stories well but have never noticed the people setting up the room. This year the children will make a display to thank those helpers. A short message about a useful act is welcome; buying a large present is not necessary.

sections.label: B
units:
Our school is small, with six classes beside a village field. We have grass to play on and no fence around it. Mr Reed, our maths teacher, makes lessons lively with games about lines and shapes. Once we made a square by holding a long piece of string. We call him Uncle Reed because he listens to our ideas.

Our English teacher is Ms Bell. She brings songs and little stories into the lessons. **They** give us chances to meet a new word more than once, and help us remember it. We can sometimes choose which story to hear again. Mr Cole teaches PE and likes the trees at the edge of the field.

This picture shows the four of us. Mr Cole is sitting on a low branch. Mr Reed is the man in dark sunglasses. Ms Bell and I stand under the tree. I am the shortest person and am wearing a little cap. Nobody in the picture is holding a ball.

sections.label: C
units:
In our school story, a language group follows a routine for remembering sounds. A new member listens to a short word twice and tries to keep its sound in mind. Speaking comes next. The teacher does not begin by handing out a page to copy. She wants the children to know what they are trying to say before they say it.

The group meets for a few short games each week. Members hear the words, choose suitable pictures and use the words again. Repeated practice across different days is the important part of this routine. One long look at a list is not enough for the group’s activity. The story does not claim that every child remembers in exactly the same way.

Amir and Zoe heard two languages at home when they were small children, before primary school. Their club friends mostly hear the new language in school activities. Other lessons fill much of the timetable, leaving less time to practise it. That is why the teacher includes small opportunities to listen and speak again whenever the club meets.

sections.label: D
units:
Dear Mother, when you feed me first,
I hear your humming by the door.
You brush the dust out of my fur.

At night I kiss your gentle hand;
It is the last thing I will kiss.
Beside you is my favourite place.

I sweep the steps with careful hands,
Then count the plates we need for tea.
I put them where the table stands.

I help to fold the washing too,
And bring clean towels for us three.
There is a little I can do.

questions.stem: A组 · Check the calendar. When does Brook Club hold Readers’ Day?
questions.rationale: A：是第四个星期日；B：九月第二个星期日计算；C：是首个星期日；D：是第三个星期日

questions.stem: A组 · Who are “They” in the second paragraph?
options: The young readers choosing a story.
The families arriving for the event.
questions.rationale: A：书不是会抵达和整理的人；B：摆椅放书的帮助者提前来留下整理；C：此处主语是布置房间的helpers；D：家庭在这些帮助者之后到

questions.stem: A组 · Which statement agrees with the passage?
options: Brook follows Pine Hill’s date every year.
Brook and Pine Hill have different event dates.
Every visitor must buy a large present.
Pine Hill’s event is on Brook’s second Sunday.
questions.rationale: A：明确不必跟对方日期；B：第二星期日和20日不相同；C：明确大礼物不必要；D：PineHill为20日

questions.stem: B组 · What is true about the school?
options: Its playground grass has a fence all round it.
It has more than twenty classes.
It has six classes beside a village field.
questions.rationale: A：草地无围墙；B：明确六班；C：开头明确六班村田边；D：MrReed是数学教师

questions.stem: B组 · What does the bold “They” refer to?
options: The new words without their stories.
All the trees beside the field.
questions.rationale: A：材料给新词重复机会，非词本身代指；B：绳子在数学段非代指；C：最近前句的两种英语材料；D：树在后句非前文代词所指

questions.stem: B组 · Which picture agrees with the description of the four people?
questions.rationale: A：体育教师在枝、墨镜数学教师、女教师孩子在地面；B：戴小帽孩子上枝，与作者树下冲突；C：墨镜数学教师上枝，非体育教师；D：英语女教师上枝，与其树下冲突

questions.stem: C组 · What does a new member do before speaking a word?
questions.rationale: A：未要求先抄整页；B：未要求先做拼写测验；C：先听并记声音，随后才说；D：与先听顺序相反

questions.stem: C组 · Which practice is important in the group’s routine?
options: Look at a list only once.
questions.rationale: A：没有禁止全部图像活动的安排；B：与重复练习相反；C：未声称人人单次即时学会；D：不同日短练复现词语

questions.stem: C组 · When did Amir and Zoe start hearing two languages at home?
questions.rationale: A：文中before入小学而非小学毕业后；B：未以前会写故事为条件；C：文中两名儿童幼时入小学前已听家庭语言；D：家庭语言接触早于社团

questions.stem: C组 · Why is time for the new language limited for some members?
options: They listen only once a year.
questions.rationale: A：其他课程占用课表时间；B：文中正有社团；C：社团安排复练，非禁止；D：没有一年仅听一次的规则

questions.stem: D组 · When is the first poem most likely to be spoken?
questions.rationale: A：非中午；B：与夜晚睡前场景不同；C：非午后；D：夜灯、月亮、盖毯与入睡支持夜间

questions.stem: D组 · Who is the first poem most probably for?
questions.rationale: A：小手、玩具、睡床等指向孩子；B：不是园丁劳作情境；C：玩具和卧室非旅客出行场景；D：没有成人教师上课情境

questions.stem: D组 · What is the last thing kissed in the second poem?
questions.rationale: A：此处明确亲吻hand，非该身体部位；B：诗句明确最后亲吻手；C：此处明确亲吻hand，非该身体部位；D：此处明确亲吻hand，非该身体部位

questions.stem: D组 · What quality does the third poem show in its speaker?
questions.rationale: A：细心整理而非粗心；B：未呈愤怒；C：主动愿意，非不愿；D：主动扫地、摆器皿和整理表达愿帮助

questions.stem: D组 · Which theme best connects the three poems?
questions.rationale: A：哄睡、母亲照料和家务帮助共同家庭关爱；B：不是三首共同体育游戏主题；C：不是三首共同旅行主题；D：不是三首共同测验主题

calendar_pronoun_evidence: The helpers prepare seats and place books where young readers can reach them. They arrive before the families and stay to put everything away.

stanzas: Your picture book is closed at last;
The little lamp is glowing low.
I draw the curtain on the day;
Our busy feet have ceased to go.
Your small toy boat lies on its side;
Your tiny hand rests near my own.
The moon is keeping watch outside;
You need not drift to sleep alone.
Dear Mother, when you feed me first,
I hear your humming by the door.
You brush the dust out of my fur.
At night I kiss your gentle hand;
It is the last thing I will kiss.
Beside you is my favourite place.
I sweep the steps with careful hands,
Then count the plates we need for tea.
I put them where the table stands.
I help to fold the washing too,
And bring clean towels for us three.
There is a little I can do.
